scope_note: Expected outputs for the 8 unseen products of blind calibration round 2 (sample_ids in data/research/styling-inci/v1.0/capture/round2-new-r4.json), derived only from those 8 capture records under styling-classification-standard.md v0.2, 02_evidence_lexicon.v0.2.md, 01_property-set-v0.md, 00_category_charter.md, the rulings ledger (SD1-SD5, D1-D8b, PH1-1..16, PH2-1..12, R1-Q1..Q4, R1-T, R1-H1..H3) and the Leave-in / Mask sections the Styling standard cites. Written before any blind lane was scored. Firmness: 'firm' = the rule determines the value unambiguously from the record; 'soft' = judgment involved (alternatives listed; any listed alternative is an acceptable lane answer, the 'value' is the expected one); 'UNDETERMINED' = the standard does not decide the value (a finding; 'acceptable' lists the answers a lane may give, 'leaning' is this lane's reading). Keys named informational_* and records whose route is not styling carry Styling values that are NOT scoring targets (standard 4.7).

conventions.ranks: 1-based; split at ',' (and '·', '•') outside brackets; a comma inside an ingredient name is not a separator (lexicon 0.4 item 2: '1,2-Hexanediol' is one token — got2b has 18 items, a naive split gives 19; tail only, no value moves). 'Aqua (Water, Eau)' is one token. Item counts: 22, 12, 18, 9, 18, 18, 29, 15.
conventions.T_S: full Mask rule (PH2-9, lexicon 0.2): earliest of fragrance, declared allergen/aroma chemical, PR-1 preservative (enumerated list), PR-2 booster only with a PR-1 declared, CH-1 chelator; third-limb unresolved readings per standard 3.3
conventions.T_LI: LI 3.1.1 capped list plus other Annex V preservatives; fragrance/allergens never eligible; statuses plausible/implausible/vacuous/none_visible; T_LI triggers fire only on paths whose border rule reads T_LI (RG-18)
conventions.claim_tiers: dm pages for Balea are C2_house_brand (LI 2.4.1 rule 6); German-language manufacturer pages are C2; got2b INCI on dm is C3 but matches the C2 got2b.de list

records.product: Balea Overnight Wellenspray, 150 ml, aerosol (dm house brand, EAN 4070765016598)
records.intended_trap: Salt-free wave spray vs salt_spray. The name says 'Wellenspray' and the capture candidate is salt_spray, but the promise is a heatless overnight curl/wave set with flexible hold (VP/VA r5), no salt, no beach/texture promise. Secondary: Sodium Bisulfite r7 (an Annex V substance not in PR-1) as a possible marker; Aqua r9 sits between the two marker readings, so 'aqueous' depends on it.
records.trap_assessment: Route is robust (styling, not held, on every path). Subtype is the trap: the salt_spray job anchor is 'beachy, piecey texture' and the 'salt-free beach spray is still salt_spray' note covers beach sprays only, so salt_spray is not expected. No anchor in the 12-subtype table describes an overnight setting spray => subtype UNDETERMINED (lean gel).

identity_status.rationale: dm house-brand page with EAN 4070765016598 and a single INCI; no conflicting capture. Pack photo not read is a capture gap, not an identity defect (RG-7).

alternatives.when: if an Annex V sulfite is read as a PR-1 preservative (lexicon T_S class (c) names only the enumerated PR-1 list; Sodium Bisulfite is not on it)

T_S.rationale: Earliest enumerated marker-class member: Potassium Sorbate r13 (PR-1). Citric Acid r12 is PH-1 (never a marker); Lavandula extract r11 is not a fragrance declaration. No value moves between the two readings except 'aqueous' (Aqua r9).

alternatives.when: T_LI explicitly admits 'any other EU Annex V preservative'; inorganic sulphites/bisulphites are an Annex V entry, but here the species is more likely an antioxidant

T_LI.rationale: Either reading: VP/VA r5 and Laurtrimonium r6 sit above it; tail carries extracts/humectants => not vacuous. Only read if the path is 3.4(iii).

aqueous.rationale: Aqua r9 is above T_S under the Potassium Sorbate reading (aqueous); under the Sodium Bisulfite reading water is tail-only (non-aqueous => 3.5). Route identical either way.

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 house-brand promise lines, C2 house-brand directions, complete INCI, identity verified.

lead_promise.value: Styling-Spray für Locken über Nacht (first C2 line; the name job word 'Wellen-' gives the same wave/curl job)
lead_promise.rationale: No C1 pack-front line captured. Both candidate leads state the same job (curl/wave creation).

promise_class.rationale: Visible styling result (curls/waves set overnight, 'fixiert die Frisur'). No care, heat or refresh lead; 'Schonendes Styling ohne Hitze' is a method line, not a heat-protection promise.

li_function.rationale: Curl/wave wording in the lead ('für Locken', 'verleiht Wellen und Locken ... Sprungkraft') reads as curl support; alternative 'no' if the set-with-curlers job is read as shaping/hold only. Route unchanged.

route.rationale: Every path lands on styling: li_function yes => 3.4(iii) LI G0 excluded_styling_first; li_function no => 3.4(ii); non-aqueous reading => 3.5.

reason_code.rationale: Follows li_function and the aqueous reading.

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 styling_result, li_function yes -> 3.1 n/a (not a shine lead) -> 3.2/3.3 n/a -> 3.4 aqueous -> (i) no (not a curl cream) -> (ii) skipped (li_function yes) -> (iii) LI G0: VP/VA r5 (LI L5) above T_LI; conditioning = Laurtrimonium Chloride r6 alone (no fatty alcohol, no silicone, no oil) = COND low = thin; positioning C2 'Flexibler Halt', 'fixiert die Frisur zuverlässig über Nacht' => excluded_styling_first => styling

held_pending_leave_in_addendum.rationale: Locked LI letter (L5 only): VP/VA is L5 with thin conditioning => LI excludes it (excluded_styling_first); 3.4(ii)/3.5 routes are never held.

styling_subtype.rationale: Job (C2 lead): create/define curls and waves with flexible hold; moment: damp or dry, set with curlers or braids overnight. No anchor covers a heatless overnight setting spray. gel: 'hold + definition, damp or dry, shaped by hand'; spray-gel tie-break precedent (Langhaarmädchen liquid curl-hold spray => gel). hairspray: alcohol/VP-VA aerosol that 'fixiert die Frisur', but its moment is not dry_finish. mousse: 'wave/curl lift, damp before drying', but form is a spray, not foam. NOT salt_spray: its job anchor is beachy, piecey texture; the salt-free note covers beach sprays; nothing here promises beach waves or texture. A lane that emits salt_spray has fallen into the trap.

result_mechanisms.rationale: Above T_S (either reading): Alcohol Denat. (AL-1), Butane/Propane (VC-1), Propylene Glycol (HU-1), VP/VA r5 (FX-1), Laurtrimonium Chloride (CA-1, never a mechanism), Panthenol/Glycerin (HU-1, not credited because a mechanism exists). Sodium Bisulfite is unlisted (no mechanism).

weight.rationale: No persistent family above T_S: Laurtrimonium Chloride is monomeric (CA-1) with no FA-1 partner => no LGN pair, no family.

buildup_note.rationale: No permanent_cationic above T_S (Laurtrimonium is monomeric); weight not rich.

ingredient_flags.rationale: Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil is an essential oil (no oils flag). Sodium Bisulfite is neither SA-1 nor Sodium Chloride (no salt flag) — the 'Wellenspray' name and the free-from 'ölfrei' line never set flags.

provides_heat_protection.rationale: No heat-protection claim ('ohne Hitze' is a method statement).

application_moment.rationale: 'In das feuchte oder trockene Haar sprühen' => first-named moment primary (firm). also[]: dry hair then set with curlers/braids read as dry_restyle (shaped); alternative also = [] if tool-setting is not read as shaping.

target_zone.rationale: No zone for the application; 'Für Wellen die Haare vom Ansatz an flechten' is a braiding step, not an application site, so the Ansatz is not the first-named application site.

heat_activated.rationale: No heat role; the product is sold as heatless.

chaarlie_hold_level.rationale: Only hold claim is C2 house-brand 'Flexibler Halt': a flexibility word, not a strength word; 'zuverlässig' is unquantified. No dm 'Halt' attribute captured => null ('Halt: keine Herstellerangabe').

flexibility.rationale: 'Flexibler Halt' => flexibel. 'verhindert ein Verkleben' is not a flexibility word (PH1-5).

finish.rationale: No finish word ('Sprungkraft' is a movement word).

primary_job.rationale: First job-bearing phrase: 'für Locken' / 'Wellen' => curl/wave definition (gate: fixative_film passes). Alternative hold_fix if curl-setting is read as shaping/forming wording.

secondary_jobs.rationale: RG-12 adds hold_fix only for a hold claim with a strength word; 'Flexibler Halt' has none. Alternative [hold_fix] from 'fixiert die Frisur'.

d8b_flags.rationale: No strength claim >= stark; not a shine/smoothing/refresher subtype; hold mechanism present anyway.

neutral_fact.rationale: Shown iff subtype is hold-relevant (gel/hairspray/mousse all are), level null and hold_route present. Not shown only if a lane chooses salt_spray (the trap).

derived.hold_display: Halt: keine Herstellerangabe + neutral fact (if hold-relevant subtype)

captured_claims: free_from C2 'ohne Farbstoffe, ölfrei / fettfrei, vegan'
other C2 'den ganzen Tag hält' (duration-like, never a level)

review_triggers.rationale: C2 rests on the dm house-brand rule. No marker trigger (T_S plausible; T_LI plausible and non-vacuous).

undetermined: styling_subtype: no subtype anchor for a heatless overnight curl/wave setting spray (standard 5 anchor table; D1). Lean gel; hairspray/mousse defensible; salt_spray is not.
rule_gaps: Lexicon T_S class (c) is the enumerated PR-1 list while T_LI admits 'any other Annex V preservative': an Annex V antioxidant/preservative such as Sodium Bisulfite can be a T_LI member but not a T_S member. Here it flips 'aqueous' (Aqua r9) but not the route.
The directions end with a valve hint mentioning a 'Schaumkopf' (foam head) on a spray: possible copied text; it is not an application instruction, so it is not treated as 'copied directions' (6.11).
sections_used: lexicon 0.2, 0.3, FX-1, CA-1, HU-1, AL-1, VC-1, PR-1

records.product: Balea Haarwachs Styling Stick, 25 g, stick (dm house brand, EAN 4067796173666)
records.intended_trap: Hairline vs surface target_zone on a wax stick (round-1 slot 2 gap, RG-20): bullets say 'Bändigt abstehende Babyhaare', directions say 'abstehende Härchen fixieren'. Also: §5 rule 2 'gel-type shaping product' on a non-gel; anhydrous wax (3.5); molding vs shine_finish job.
records.trap_assessment: target_zone is U and reads the directions only: 'abstehende Härchen' (flyaways) => surface, not hairline (the 'Babyhaare' bullet is a claim and never sets a U field). §5 rule 2 cannot fire (not gel-type, and directions do not lead with edges). Subtype molding vs shine_finish is not decided by the standard.

identity_status.rationale: dm house-brand page with EAN; single INCI; no conflict.

T_S.rationale: No preservative declared; Parfum r9 is the earliest marker class; Linalool r12 follows it.

T_LI.rationale: No capped preservative. Not read on this path (3.5), so no T_LI trigger (RG-18).

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 house-brand promise and directions, complete INCI.

lead_promise.value: Haarwachs-Stift für trendige Styles (first C2 line; the name has no job word)
alternatives: 'Für ein glattes & glänzendes Finish' if a lane treats line 1 as a product descriptor

promise_class.rationale: Styling look / shine-sleek finish; no care, heat or refresh lead.

li_function.rationale: Lead is styling/shaping; the flyaway line is anti-frizz on dry, finished hair by the main directions ('über das trockene Haar') => shine-finish job, li_function no either way.

route.rationale: Non-aqueous, class styling_result, not sold as Öl/Serum.

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 styling_result, li_function no -> 3.1 skip or continue (not Öl/Serum) -> 3.2/3.3 n/a -> 3.4 n/a (non-aqueous) -> 3.5 => styling

held_pending_leave_in_addendum.rationale: 3.5 routes are not held (LI could only say excluded_anhydrous).

styling_subtype.rationale: Rule 2 (hairline gel) does not fire: a wax stick is not gel-type and the directions do not lead with edges. Step 3: the lead line 'Haarwachs-Stift für trendige Styles' carries no job but the product noun (RG-11 fallback => hold_fix => molding job), and the wax form would break a tie toward molding. The specific claims ('glattes & glänzendes Finish', 'Bändigt abstehende Babyhaare', 'Sleek-Look') and the only directions (stroke over dry hair to fix flyaways, no shaping => dry_finish) are the shine_finish anchor 'shine, flyaway control on dry hair' (R1-Q2). The standard does not say which of the two job readings wins.

result_mechanisms.rationale: Value wax_lipid is firm; the r7/r8 hydrogenated oils are not enumerated (WL-1 lists only hydrogenated castor/coconut oil) — membership soft, moves no value (Carnauba r6 already gives structuring). Stearyl Alcohol r3 is FA-1 (WT only, not a mechanism).

weight.rationale: Families above T_S: (a) WL-6 oils (Almond r1, Coconut r4 rich band), (b) WL-4 butters (Mango r2, Shea r5) and WL-1 wax (Carnauba r6), (c) FA-1 Stearyl Alcohol r3 => >= 2 families with rich members.

alcohol_note.rationale: No AL-1 member; Stearyl Alcohol is FA-1.

application_moment.rationale: 'sparsam über das trockene Haar streichen, um abstehende Härchen zu fixieren': dry hair, applied over the style, no separate shaping step => dry_finish; dry_restyle if the stroking itself is read as shaping.

target_zone.rationale: Directions name 'abstehende Härchen' (stray/flyaway hairs) with no edge, baby-hair or brow word => surface ('the outer layer or flyaways of a finished style only'). hairline only if 'Härchen' is equated with the C2 bullet 'Babyhaare' — but bullets are claims and never set a U field. First recorded surface case (property set 2.14: none in cohort).

chaarlie_hold_level.rationale: No hold claim at any tier; 'fixieren' is in the directions, 'das den ganzen Tag hält' is a duration of the finish.

flexibility.rationale: 'ohne dass die Haare verkleben' is not a flexibility word.

finish.rationale: C2 'glattes & glänzendes Finish'. F sanity: not a particulate powder => no conflict.

primary_job.rationale: Lead line has no job-bearing phrase besides the product noun 'Haarwachs' (fallback => hold_fix; gate passes via structuring Carnauba r6). If a lane takes the finish line as lead => shine (gate wax_lipid passes) or 'Sleek-Look' => sleek.

secondary_jobs.rationale: Claim order: shine word ('glänzendes Finish') then flyaway word ('Bändigt abstehende Babyhaare'); both pass the gate (wax_lipid). Changes if the primary is shine.

d8b_flags.rationale: No hold claim of any kind; structuring wax present anyway.

neutral_fact.rationale: hold_route absent => never shown, whichever subtype.

cautions: medically adjacent pomade caution 'Nicht direkt am Haaransatz oder auf der Stirn auftragen.' fires if subtype molding (rich/anhydrous) or if target_zone hairline (wax_lipid + hairline); not under shine_finish + surface

captured_claims: other C2 'ideal für den angesagten Sleek-Look oder um abstehende Babyhaare zu bändigen'

review_triggers.rationale: No marker trigger (T_S plausible; T_LI not read on 3.5).

undetermined: styling_subtype: molding (lead-line product-noun fallback + wax form) vs shine_finish (specific claims + dry-hair flyaway directions, R1-Q2) — standard 5 step 3 / 6.10 RG-11 do not rank a generic lead line against specific job lines.
rule_gaps: Hydrogenated Rapeseed Oil / Hydrogenated Palm Oil are not enumerated in WL-1 (only hydrogenated castor/coconut) or clearly in WL-6; no value moves here.
RG-20 gap partly exercised: §5 rule 2 'gel-type shaping product' is still undefined, but this product fails it on directions anyway.

records.product: got2b Kleber 4 Brows & Edges 2in1 Stylinggel, 16 ml, gel tube with brush (EAN 4015100863208)
records.intended_trap: Hairline edge gel (§5 rule 2, D1) with brows as a second use (PH1-7, one route); 'Haaransatz' vs the RG-9 'Ansatz => roots' rule; 'Kleber' after RG-14 (rigidity word, not strength); FX-2 unconditional acrylate beside an RH-1 crosspolymer.
records.trap_assessment: gel via §5 rule 2 (directions lead with brows, then hairline/edges => target_zone hairline, not roots: the brows are the first-named site). Hold 3 from 'starken' (not 4 from 'Kleber'); flexibility fest from the name word 'Kleber' (P-2).

identity_status.rationale: EAN on dm; INCI on dm (C3) matches got2b.de's German-name list (C2) set-for-set; the got2b.de 'PEG[1]40' is a page typo, not a formula difference.

T_S.rationale: First PR-1; boosters (Caprylyl Glycol r8, Ethylhexylglycerin) follow it.

T_LI.rationale: Tail holds AMP, PEG-40 HCO, Glycerin, Panthenol => not vacuous. Only cross-check paths read it.

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 got2b.de promise and directions; INCI C3 corroborated by C2.

lead_promise.value: Perfekte Augenbrauen und Haarkonturen! ... sorgt für starken und langanhaltenden Halt (first C2 line; the name has no single job word)
lead_promise.rationale: '2in1' names two zones (brows + edges), not two classes => not mixed.

promise_class.rationale: Shape/hold of brows and hair contours.

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 styling_result, li_function no -> 3.1-3.3 n/a -> 3.4 aqueous -> (ii) styling directly (PH2-1). Cross-check: LI G0 PVP r2 above T_LI, no conditioning => excluded_styling_first, same route

held_pending_leave_in_addendum.rationale: 3.4(ii) route; LI letter would exclude it anyway (PVP is L5).

styling_subtype.rationale: Directions lead with brows and the hair at the hairline/edges ('Augenbrauen und die Haare am Haaransatz', 'Augenbrauen und Kanten') => hairline; the product is a gel ('Stylinggel', PVP + acrylate film in a crosspolymer gel). Brow use is recorded only (PH1-7, A8).

result_mechanisms.rule: standard 6.1; lexicon FX-1, FX-2 (unconditional name), RH-1
result_mechanisms.rationale: Acrylates/Steareth-20 Methacrylate Crosspolymer r4 is RH-1 (never a mechanism). The r3 acrylate is an unconditional FX-2 name, so FX-2c corroboration is not needed.

alcohol_note.rationale: First 3: Aqua, PVP, acrylate; Benzyl Alcohol never counts.

ingredient_flags.rationale: PEG-40 Hydrogenated Castor Oil is ethoxylated (no oils flag); Citrus Aurantium Peel Oil is an essential oil.

application_moment.rationale: Directions give a shaping step with the brush but no moisture state, no drying, no heat. dry_restyle requires 'applied to dry hair'; RG-2 covers spray-only directions without a moisture state, not shaping directions. The standard has no default for 'no moisture state + shaping'.

target_zone.rationale: First-named site is the brows (hairline class); 'Haaransatz' here is the hair contour ('Kanten'), and RG-9's roots reading needs the Ansatz to be the only or first-named site — it is second.

chaarlie_hold_level.rationale: C2 'sorgt für starken und langanhaltenden Halt' => stark => 3. No brand number captured (Henkel x/5 table not reached). 'Kleber' is a rigidity word only (RG-14), never 4. 'langanhaltend' unquantified.

flexibility.rationale: Confirmed name word 'Kleber' => flexibility claim from_product_name: true => fest. 'nicht klebend' is not a negated rigidity word (it is the 'ohne zu verkleben' family, PH1-5). Note: 'Kleber' is also got2b's range name; the rule reads the word literally.

primary_job.rationale: Lead line names brows/contours; 'bleiben ... in Form' (shaping) and the strength phrase both map to hold_fix. Alternative sleek (laid edges) if a lane reads 'perfekte Haarkonturen' as a sleek look.

secondary_jobs.rationale: The strength-word hold claim maps to hold_fix, already primary; no anti-frizz, shine or definition words.

duration-like C2 'langer Tag ... lassen dich nicht im Stich' (never a level)

undetermined: application_moment: shaping directions with no moisture state (standard 6.11 / property set 2.13 have no default; RG-2 covers spray-only directions only).

records.product: Wella Professionals EIMI Volume Dry Me (Trockenshampoo), 180 ml, aerosol (no GTIN on page)
records.intended_trap: A 'Trockenshampoo' with volume and matte-texture claims vs the Dry Shampoo tie rule (standard 4.2 tie precedence, 4.3 step 3.2). Capture candidate: texture_spray.
records.trap_assessment: Caught: the C2 promise co-leads volume/matte texture with freshness and oil absorption ('erfrischt Ihr Haar und absorbiert Öl') => refresh class (tie) => 3.2 dry_shampoo. Even if the name job word 'Volume' is taken as the lead, 3.2's second limb (promise positioned on oil absorption) gives dry_shampoo.

identity_status.rule: standard 2.1, 2.3 (LI 2.4 G1: GTIN or a documented gap)
identity_status.rationale: INCI from the German manufacturer page; GTIN not on page (documented gap); no conflicting capture.

T_LI.rationale: No preservative; not read on path 3.2.

aqueous.rationale: Water r6 is above T_S Fragrance r9 => aqueous by the rank rule (a counter-intuitive reading for an aerosol powder spray; informational consequence below).

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 manufacturer DE page (promise, directions, INCI).

lead_promise.value: first C2 line: '... einem Trockenshampoo, das Volumen und eine handhabbare, matte Textur schafft. Die Formel ... erfrischt Ihr Haar und absorbiert Öl.'
alternatives: name step 1 'Volume' if '(Trockenshampoo)' is not part of the confirmed name (then two job words do not arise)
lead_promise.rationale: With '(Trockenshampoo)' the name has two job words (R1-H1) => first C2 line.

alternatives: styling_result (if the name job word 'Volume' is the lead)
promise_class.rationale: Refresh (freshness/oil absorption) + volume/texture co-lead => refresh, promise_tie: refresh_plus_volume_texture.

route.rationale: Class refresh => 3.2; and independently the promise is positioned on oil absorption ('absorbiert Öl', 'Trockenshampoo') => 3.2. The formula (starch, silica) never decides this boundary.

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 refresh (tie precedence, promise_tie: refresh_plus_volume_texture) -> 3.1 n/a -> 3.2 => dry_shampoo

records.product: Syoss Glaze Glanz & Schutz Primer, pump spray (size/GTIN not on page)
records.intended_trap: Heat protection + shine primer: tests 3.3 (heat lead?), 3.1 (shine lead, not Öl/Serum), the R1-H1 two-job-word name rule, the co-equal '3in1 Style, Care, Shine' lead, PH1-15 (heat claim without an L9 member). Capture candidate: smoothing_styler.
records.trap_assessment: Caught at step 2: the first C2 line joins styling and care in a '3 in 1' ('Style, pflege und repariere') => mixed; D7 cannot fire (not a curl/styling cream, no fixative) => provisional_boundary (mixed_promise). The name 'Glanz & Schutz' has two job words and does not decide (R1-H1); read as a lead it would be co-equal too. Not heat_protectant (heat is a bullet), not smoothing_styler.

identity_status.rationale: INCI from syoss.de; GTIN and size not on page (documented gap); format assumed pump (no propellant).

T_LI.rationale: Tail carries Triethyl Citrate, Panthenol, CCT, extracts => not vacuous. Read by the D7 test (PH1-12) on the mixed path; no T_LI trigger fires.

lead_promise.value: '3 in 1 Formel: Style, pflege und repariere dein Haar für Looks mit einem Laminierungs-Effekt ...' (first C2 line; the name 'Glaze Glanz & Schutz Primer' has two job words, R1-H1)

promise_class.rule: standard 4.2 (co-equal lead via '3in1' naming both classes)
promise_class.rationale: Styling + care in the lead itself; second line '3in1 Style, Care, Shine' confirms. Not care + curl definition (R1-Q3 not involved); no refresh tie.

li_function.rationale: Care, anti-frizz on damp hair, blow-dry/heat support are LI 2.1 functions (R1-Q2: anti-frizz for damp hair keeps the Leave-in check). Not route-deciding on the mixed path.

route.rationale: D7 runs first (PH1-12): no fixative-class polymer above T_LI and not sold as a curl/styling cream or balm => D7 does not fire => mixed stop.

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 lead = first C2 line ('3in1 Style, pflege und repariere') => mixed -> D7 test first: limb 1 fails (no FX; Triethyl Citrate is PL-1), limb 3 fails ('Primer') -> provisional_boundary (mixed_promise); stays in its current category, review

both_readings.styling_reading: If 'Style/Glanz' alone led: shine lead -> 3.1 in scope, not Öl/Serum -> continue -> 3.4 aqueous, li_function yes (damp-hair anti-frizz, blow-dry primer) -> (iii) LI G0: no L5 fixative; conditioning above T_LI only the unlisted Polyglyceryl-3 Betainate Acetate r2 => G0 in_category or provisional_boundary; D6 limb 1 (no real hold) holds, limb 2 (no real care) turns on whether Polyglyceryl-3 Betainate Acetate is a cationic conditioner (unlisted) => unresolved. Never a confident styling route.
both_readings.care_reading: If 'pflege und repariere' led: class care -> 3.4(iii) LI G0 (blow-dry primer with heat claim) -> leave_in or LI provisional_boundary.

styling_subtype.rationale: mixed_promise: no subtype (capture candidate smoothing_styler is not expected).

informational_styling_values.hold_route: absent (Triethyl Citrate r7 is PL-1, not a fixative)
informational_styling_values.weight: light; candidate_below_tail: Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride r11 (WL-7) would make it medium
informational_styling_values.provides_heat_protection: false (claim_only: C2 'Bis zu 230°C Hitzeschutz', no HP-1 member) => shown 'Hitzeschutz laut Hersteller', heat_claim_without_l9
informational_styling_values.application_moment: before_heat ('ins feuchte Haar sprühen und anschließend föhnen' — blow-dry is the required next step)

review_triggers.rationale: The route-level trigger is s0_mixed_promise; the other two belong to the non-authoritative Styling block.

rule_gaps: Polyglyceryl-3 Betainate Acetate (a quaternary betaine ester sold as a conditioner) is in no lexicon family; it would decide the D6 care limb on the counterfactual styling reading.

records.product: Redken Wax Spray (Spray Wax), aerosol (redken.eu/de-de; no GTIN/size on page)
records.intended_trap: A wax in spray form: name and description say wax ('Sprühwachs', 'Microwax-Technologie') but the formula has no wax above the tail (VA/Crotonates r4 film only; Soybean Oil r12 and Octyldodecanol r10 sit in the fragrance/allergen block). Also: hold word 'mittlerer Kontrolle' (not 'Halt'); allergen-above-Parfum marker (Mask E2 shape); FX-4 alone.
records.trap_assessment: SFS-1 caught if the lane reads no wax_lipid and does not set molding by name. Subtype texture_spray from the 'Texturierendes' lead (soft vs molding). Hold level not decided by the standard ('Kontrolle').

identity_status.rationale: INCI from the German-language Redken Germany page; GTIN not on page (documented gap).

alternatives: C5 if redken.eu/de-de were read as a non-German EU page (LI 2.4.1 rule 3)
claim_tier_note.rationale: A German-language page addressed to the German market ('Redken Germany') is C2 for a foreign brand.

alt.note: next ordinally consistent member if Benzyl Alcohol is read as PR-1 (lexicon AL-X/PR-1); if it is read as a declared allergen above Parfum too, the next consistent member is Parfum r18

T_S.rationale: Benzyl Salicylate is a declared allergen ranked above the list's own Parfum (r18) => unresolved (the Mask E2 / Elnett Haarspray shape).

alternatives.when: if Benzyl Alcohol is not 'as preservative'

T_LI.rationale: Not read on path 3.5 => no T_LI trigger (RG-18).

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 promise and directions, complete INCI.

lead_promise.value: 'REDKEN WAX SPRAY Texturierendes Sprühwachs.' (first C2 line; the name has no job word)

route.rationale: Non-aqueous styling_result; not Öl/Serum; 3.1 not in scope (texture lead).

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 styling_result (texture), li_function no -> 3.1 skip -> 3.2 texture with no refresh => continue -> 3.3 n/a -> 3.4 n/a (non-aqueous) -> 3.5 => styling

held_pending_leave_in_addendum.rationale: 3.5 route; the FX-4-alone double-claim case applies only where LI could claim the product — here LI could only say excluded_anhydrous.

styling_subtype.rationale: Job from the lead: texture ('Texturierendes'; plus 'Volumen und Körper', 'seidig-mattes Finish', 'Struktur') = texture_spray anchor 'dry grip, airy volume, matte texture'; spray form. A name never decides (SFS-1): the formula has no wax above T_S. Moment: first-named damp (RG-8), also dry_restyle — the anchor moment is dry_restyle, so job carries it.

result_mechanisms.rationale: Under both marker readings (r7, r9) only FX-4 sits above; Linalool r8 unpositioned (moves nothing). No wax_lipid: Octyldodecanol r10 (unlisted emollient) and Soybean Oil r12 are below T_S.

alternatives: unknown (if R2 marker = Parfum r18: Soybean Oil r12 and Octyldodecanol r10 become positioned, readings disagree => unknown, standard 3.3 step 3)
weight.rationale: R1 (r7) and R2 = Benzyl Alcohol r9 both give no persistent family => light.

ingredient_flags.rationale: oils: Glycine Soja Oil anywhere on the list; propellant: Dimethyl Ether; fixative_family from FX-4 VA/Crotonates above T_S.

application_moment.rationale: 'Auf das feuchte oder trockene Haar sprühen. Mit den Händen die gewünschte Frisur formen.' First-named damp (drying unspecified => damp_before_drying); dry + hand shaping => dry_restyle in also[].

chaarlie_hold_level.rationale: C2 'fixierender Haarspray mit mittlerer Kontrolle': 'mittel' => 2 if 'Kontrolle' is read as hold; null if 'Kontrolle' is another result noun (the RG-13 'qualifies another result noun' test is written for names only). The standard does not say whether 'Kontrolle' = Halt. Not used in selection if the subtype is texture_spray (7.1).

finish.rationale: C2 'seidig-mattes Finish': matt word; 'seidig' is not a finish word. F sanity: formula is fixative-led, not oil/silicone-led => no finish_formula_conflict.

primary_job.rationale: 'Texturierendes' is the first job-bearing word; gate: a film (fixative_film) passes.

secondary_jobs.rationale: hold_fix only if 'mittlerer Kontrolle' is a strength-word hold claim; RG-12 names no volume trigger, so 'Volumen und Körper' is not added on the letter.

d8b_flags.rationale: No claim >= stark; not shine/smoothing/refresher; hold mechanism present.

alternatives: 'Enthält Stylingpolymere (z. B. VA/Crotonates/Vinyl Neodecanoate Copolymer)' if a lane chooses molding or hairspray AND reads the level as null
neutral_fact.rationale: texture_spray is not hold-relevant => never shown.

alternatives: molding view: form_label wax, base anhydrous (if subtype molding)

captured_claims: other C2 'Microwax-Technologie ... Finish eines Wachses' (no wax in the formula above T_S — claim only)

value.note: Soybean Oil r12 (WL-6) below T_S would move weight light -> medium

undetermined: chaarlie_hold_level: whether 'mittlerer Kontrolle' is a strength-word hold claim (standard 7.2 step 5, 7.4; RG-13 covers name words only).

R2 tail marker: Benzyl Alcohol is both a PR-1 preservative and an EU-declared allergen; standard 3.3 / lexicon third limb do not say which role decides ordinal consistency. Decides weight light vs unknown.
rule_gaps: Octyldodecanol (Guerbet alcohol emollient) is in no lexicon family (not FA-1, not WL-7).
sections_used: lexicon 0.2 third limb, FX-4, WL-6, AL-1, AL-X, PR-1, FR-2

records.product: Moroccanoil Glättende Creme (Smoothing Lotion), 300/75 ml, pump bottle (de.moroccanoil.com; no GTIN)
records.intended_trap: A smoothing cream also usable as a Leave-in-Kur (capture candidate smoothing_styler). Embedded: brand name 'Moroccanoil' contains 'oil' (D2 reads the product name only); PQ-11 r9 (FX-R) below T_S; LGN pair split by the Fragrance r6 marker; 'pflegende ... Stylingcreme' + 'Definition' (R1-Q3 question).
records.trap_assessment: Never styling: smoothing is an LI function, there is no fixative-class polymer, and the conditioning is substantive (LGN pair Cetearyl r4 + Behentrimonium r7 above T_LI, Dimethicone r3, PQ-70, PQ-11, Argan r11) => LI G0 in_category, D6 does not fire => leave_in — the exact PH2-1 Garnier Diamond Sleek pattern. Whether R1-Q3 turns it into mixed_promise is not decided.

identity_status.rationale: INCI from the German manufacturer shop; GTIN gap documented.

T_S.rationale: Earliest marker class; third limb not engaged (Fragrance itself).

T_LI.rule: LI 3.1.1 (Caprylyl Glycol in a preservative pair with Chlorphenesin/Phenoxyethanol)
T_LI.rationale: All COND/WT-establishing species (Dimethicone r3, Cetearyl r4, Behentrimonium r7, PQ-70 r8, PQ-11 r9, Argan r11, HVO r12) sit above it; tail carries Dipropylene Glycol, Glyceryl Stearate, Oleth-10 => not vacuous.

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 shop page promise, directions, INCI.

lead_promise.value: name job word 'Glättende' (smoothing) — the name names exactly one job
lead_promise.rationale: First C2 line: 'pflegende und dennoch leichte Stylingcreme bändigt krauses ... Haar ... Geschmeidigkeit und Definition ... pflegen ... spürbar glatt'.

acceptable: mixed (if R1-Q3 reads the unqualified 'Definition' on a product 'ideal für lockiges ... Haar' as curl definition)
promise_class.rationale: R1-Q3 fires only on care + curl definition; here 'Definition' is not tied to 'Locken' in the promise, and the curly-hair line is a hair_type claim. styling_result and care both lead to leave_in; only the R1-Q3 reading changes the route.

li_function.rationale: Smoothing/anti-frizz and care on damp hair; directions also name the Leave-in-Kur use.

route.rationale: Path (styling_result or care): 3.1 in scope (smoothing lead) but not sold as Öl/Serum (the brand name is not the product name) -> 3.4 aqueous -> (i) D7 no (no fixative; not a curl cream) -> (ii) skipped (li_function yes) -> (iii) LI G0 in_category (aqueous, stays on, smoothing/conditioning primary; no L5 route: PQ-11 is L1 in LI) -> D6: limb 1 holds (no FX above T_LI; PQ-11 is FX-R), limb 2 fails (real care above T_LI) => leave_in. If R1-Q3 applies: mixed -> D7 first (fails) -> provisional_boundary (mixed_promise). Styling is excluded on every reading (firm).

lean_route.rationale: No Styling lean on either reading.

styling_subtype.rationale: Non-Styling route: no subtype. smoothing_styler (capture candidate) is not expected.

records.product: Wella Professionals EIMI Glam Mist Shinespray, 200 ml, aerosol (no GTIN on page)
records.intended_trap: Control-plus-traps: shine_finish with a hold claim ('Haltegrad 1') and no hold mechanism (D8b rule 1); Alcohol Denat. at r5 (alcohol note must NOT fire); 'Glanzpomade' wording on a spray; anti-frizz on dry finished hair (R1-Q2); Wella EIMI Haltegrad is words-only; INCI with missing spaces.
records.trap_assessment: shine_finish committed (not held), D8b claim_formula_conflict fires, alcohol_note does not fire, hold level not used in selection.

identity_status.rationale: Manufacturer DE page INCI; GTIN gap documented; missing spaces repaired as unambiguous aliases ('HexylCinnamal' => Hexyl Cinnamal; 'Disiloxane,Cyclopentasiloxane' split at the comma) and logged, not a transcription_defect.

T_S.rationale: No preservative; Parfum precedes every allergen.

evidence_gate.rationale: C2 promise and directions, complete INCI.

lead_promise.value: name job word 'Shinespray' (finish) — exactly one job word
lead_promise.rationale: Matches the first C2 line 'Vollende deinen glamourösen Style mit diesem Glanzspray'.

promise_class.rationale: Shine/finish; 'Schutz ... vor Feuchtigkeit und UV' is not heat protection and not a co-equal lead.

li_function.rationale: Shine; the anti-frizz line is on dry, finished hair by the main directions ('um deinen Look ... zu vollenden').

route.rationale: 3.1 in scope (shine lead) but not sold as Öl/Serum ('Glanzpomade' in a bullet is neither); non-aqueous => 3.5.

rule_path.value: 4.1 pass -> 4.2 styling_result (shine), li_function no -> 3.1 in scope, not Öl/Serum => continue -> 3.2/3.3 n/a -> 3.4 n/a (non-aqueous) -> 3.5 => styling

styling_subtype.rationale: Shine job, dry_finish moment; the lead is shine, not hold, so the hairspray tie-break ('a hold lead => hairspray') does not apply.

result_mechanisms.rationale: Disiloxane/Cyclopentasiloxane are SI-3 volatiles; Butane/Isobutane/Propane VC-1; Alcohol Denat. AL-1.

weight.rationale: Exactly one persistent family above T_S: (d) Dimethicone r6.

alcohol_note.rationale: First 3: Butane, Disiloxane, Cyclopentasiloxane; Alcohol Denat. is r5.

provides_heat_protection.rationale: Humidity/UV protection is not a heat claim.

application_moment.rationale: Spray-only directions ('gleichmäßig auf dein Haar ... vollenden'), no moisture state, drying or shaping step; confidence moderate.

target_zone.rationale: 'auf dein Haar' — no flyaway/outer-layer-only wording, so not surface.

chaarlie_hold_level.rule: standard 7.2, 7.3 (Wella EIMI: no stated maximum => words decide), 7.4
chaarlie_hold_level.rationale: C2 'Haltegrad 1' is recorded, not normalised (words-only brand). The capture's typed hold entry carries words 'leichten Halt' => leicht => 1. If a lane accepts only verbatim promise text (no 'leichten Halt' line in claims_verbatim) => null. Stored, not used (shine_finish, 7.1).
chaarlie_hold_level.hold_basis: C2 typed hold claim words 'leichten Halt' (number 'Haltegrad 1' recorded only)

secondary_jobs.rationale: Claim order: hold claim (line 1) => hold_fix, dropped by the gate (no hold mechanism); 'Anti-Frizz-Effekt' => frizz_control (silicone_coat passes).

dropped_jobs.rationale: hold_fix is added only if the hold claim carries a strength word ('leichten'); with 'Haltegrad 1' alone it is not added and not dropped.

d8b_flags.rationale: Any hold claim ('Haltegrad 1', C2) on a shine_finish with no member of the hold-mechanism set above T_S (silicone_coat is not one).

neutral_fact.rationale: shine_finish is not hold-relevant; hold_route absent.

captured_claims: other C2 'Professionelle Glanzpomade ...' (wording on a spray; display/trace only)
rule_gaps: Capture: the typed hold entry carries words 'leichten Halt' that no verbatim claim line shows (P-6 asks that capture notes never become claim text); the level is soft for that reason only.
